name: faa-traffic-delays-mcp-server
description: Track FAA ground stops, delay programs, airport delays, the operations plan, and ATCSCC advisories.

interface.shortDescription: Track FAA ground stops, delay programs, airport delays, the operations plan, and ATCSCC advisories.
interface.longDescription: Real-time US air traffic management status from the FAA Air Traffic Control System Command Center (ATCSCC), read from the NAS Status feed and the ATCSCC advisories database. Check US airports for ground stops, Ground Delay Programs with their delay profile, arrival and departure delays, closures, and the runway configuration and arrival rate; list every active event nationwide, en-route Airspace Flow Programs included, sorted by severity; read the operations plan for programs the FAA expects later in the day; and open the full advisory text behind each program. Airport codes are checked against a bundled FAA airport directory. Keyless and read-only; the data is informational, not a source for flight planning.
